BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Toronto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

BitGo is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Trade team and help us build resilient, robust services and are responsible for working on critical projects with limited or no supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build strong, resilient, and robust APIs, libraries, and services to power our financial services: clearing and settlement, digital asset lending, trading and liquidity
  • Own functionality and scalability features by taking responsibility from inception to deployment and customer integration
  • Expose and document functionality to the UI, third-party developers, and our internal and external tooling
  • Collaborate closely with all engineering teams and product managers to ensure consistency in understanding of technical requirements and overall work quality
  • Provide mentorship to your peers in the broader engineering team through code reviews and education on best practices

Skills & Experience: 

We are looking for teammates who share and practice our values: open communication, transparency, taking ownership, and a high level of craftsmanship. We are looking for coworkers who share our vision and mission: deliver trust in digital assets. 

Required:

  • Experience with server-side languages like Golang, TypeScript/Node.JS, Java, Python, etc.
  • Experience developing or supporting financial accounting systems, such as general ledger and bookkeeping functions
  • Experience with SQL databases like MySQL or Postgres
  • Confident with RESTful API design
  • Great with unit and functional testing and debugging
  • Experience in Git/GitHub and branching methodologies, code review tools, CI tools, etc.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, applied mathematics, or another technical discipline from a top university
  • Understanding of and strong interest in cryptocurrencies and blockchain
  • Great at algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

Preferred:

  • At least 1 years of back-end, server-side software development
  • Experience with microservices and service-oriented architectures
  • Experience with large-scale, real-time, and distributed applications
  • Familiarity with Containers and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of and experience working in the financial industry
  • Familiarity with any of the following: digital wallets, clearing and settlement, lending, trading, accounting systems, etc

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Pay Transparency Notice: The compensation for this role is 165,000 CAD base salary. Equity and an annual performance bonus are also a part of this role's package.

Work from anywhere, impact everywhere 

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position 
Work from anywhere!

Position overview

As Financial Controller, you will own the integrity of financial reporting across the Xapo group, a Bitcoin-first, regulated credit institution headquartered in Gibraltar.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will lead the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams and take each cycle from first draft to sign-off: consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, the multi-entity close, regulatory returns to the GFSC and FCA, and the external audit.

You will apply IFRS to crypto assets, shape our accounting positions and policies, and work with our finance transformation team to build AI and automation into the close and reporting process.

Responsibilities

Financial reporting and control  

  • Prepare the group’s consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, from first draft to sign-off.  
  • Run month-end and year-end close for a multi-entity group in Gibraltar and the UK, including consolidation and intercompany eliminations.  
  • Oversee the statutory accounts of each group entity.  
  • Make sure the internal control system stays accurate and keeps its integrity.  

Regulatory reporting  

  • Lead regulatory reporting to the GFSC and FCA, including prudential returns on capital and liquidity and periodic management accounts.  
  • Work with Data, Operations, Compliance and other teams to prepare client asset reporting.  
  • Keep up with regulatory change and update reporting when requirements change.  

External audit  

  • Run the group external audit from planning through fieldwork, queries and sign-off.  
  • Be the main contact between Xapo and the auditors, answering technical questions and keeping the audit on timetable.  

Technical accounting  

  • Support the Director of Finance on technical accounting, including the treatment of crypto assets under IFRS.  
  • Write technical accounting positions and contribute to decisions on finance systems and infrastructure.  
  • Help draft accounting policies, memos and decision records.  

Tax  

  • Own tax compliance and manage the external tax advisors, including the tax treatment of crypto assets.  

Systems, process and automation  

  • Improve finance processes and NetSuite reporting.  
  • Work with the finance transformation team to build AI and automation into close and reporting, and adopt new tools as they roll out.  
  • Manage the existing close and regulatory reporting review process and look for ways to improve it.  

Team management  

  • Lead and develop the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams, fostering strong performance, accountability, and collaboration.   
  • Drive a high-performance culture by setting clear objectives, developing future leaders, and ensuring the team has the skills to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.

Skills needed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.  
  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred.  
  • At least 5 years as a Controller leading an accounting function.  
  • Experience in a bank, fintech or crypto business.  
  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and FRS 102, with experience preparing financial statements under both.  
  • Crypto asset accounting under IFRS, including fair value revaluation and on-chain reconciliations, backed by a working understanding of blockchain.  
  • Regulatory reporting experience, including Basel capital and liquidity returns (e.g. COREP). GFSC or FCA exposure is preferred.  
  • External audits experience.  
  • NetSuite proficiency is essential.  
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. SQL or BI tools (e.g. BigQuery, Looker) are an advantage.  
  • Has used AI tools in previous finance roles and is comfortable working alongside AI-driven automations and checking their output.  
  • Experience leading and developing a finance team.  
  • Clear writer, able to explain complex numbers to non-finance colleagues and handle regulator and auditor correspondence in a fully remote team.  
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgement and high standards of integrity.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balance
    Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. 

  • Expect Excellence
    Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

  • Deep Cloud & Container Mastery: Advanced architectural expertise with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and enterprise-scale AWS cloud services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB).

The Department: Marketing

The Prediction Markets Operations team turns real-world events into clearly defined event contracts. We support markets across their full lifecycle—from an initial idea, through configuration and launch, into live operations, and finally to accurate resolution. Our work sits at the intersection of current events, marketplaces, and regulated products, and it demands precision at every step.

The team is responsible for making sure every contract is: clearly and objectively written, based on reliable, authoritative resolution sources, accurately configured, supported with appropriate images and content, thoroughly reviewed before launch, monitored while live, and resolved accurately and consistently.

The Role: Prediction Markets Operations Intern

This is a detail-oriented, hands-on internship for someone interested in marketplaces, operations, current events, financial technology, or regulated products. You will perform time-sensitive operational work and learn firsthand how prediction markets move from an idea to a live and, ultimately, settled contract.

Success in this role depends on accuracy, sound judgment, reliability, and operational discipline. Just as important is the willingness to escalate uncertainty rather than guess. You will support, coordinate, research, prepare, review, and execute work under established procedures, working closely with partners across Prediction Markets, Operations, Customer Support, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Design, Marketing, and our liquidity partners.

This will be a semester long internship program with 3 days a week in person at our New York City, NY office from January to April 2027.

Responsibilities

Contract Research and Market Listings

  • Research potential prediction-market contract ideas.
  • Help turn ideas into precise, objective binary questions.
  • Identify reliable and authoritative public resolution sources.
  • Flag ambiguity, potentially prohibited subject matter, or questions requiring Compliance or Legal review.
  • Prepare contract specifications, including outcomes, dates, descriptions, tickers, resolution criteria, and other listing details.
  • Create and configure event contracts in the Contract Management System, or assist with structured CSV uploads, under established procedures.
  • Support research and documentation related to product requirements and filings.

Quality Assurance and Launch Operations

  • Perform pre-launch and post-upload quality assurance.
  • Verify contract names, outcomes, ordering, start times, expiration times, resolution criteria, and designated sources.
  • Review dates and times carefully, including UTC-based fields.
  • Compare contracts with relevant external prediction markets when appropriate, and identify unintended differences in outcomes, timing, or mechanics.
  • Confirm that event and social images are present and appropriate.
  • Upload or update approved event images, social images, and display settings.
  • Coordinate launch information with internal stakeholders and liquidity partners.
  • Identify discrepancies and escalate issues before launch.

Customer and Live-Market Support

  • Review, triage, and investigate prediction-market support tickets.
  • Gather relevant facts, document findings, and route issues appropriately.
  • Monitor live markets for incorrect content, timing discrepancies, operational issues, or unexpected behavior.
  • Follow established incident-escalation procedures when urgent technical or operational issues arise.
  • Maintain accurate trackers, checklists, SOPs, and internal documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve repetitive workflows and reduce manual work.

Market Monitoring and Resolution

  • Monitor contracts approaching expiration or awaiting resolution.
  • Research outcomes using the contract’s designated resolution source.
  • Prepare a proposed outcome, source links, and a concise rationale for internal review.
  • Double-check resolution information against authoritative sources.
  • Escalate unclear, conflicting, delayed, or incomplete source information rather than guessing.
  • Execute approved market settlements in the Contract Management System after required training, review, and approval.
    • Settlement activity is performed only under established procedures, supervision, access controls, and approval requirements. Accuracy is critical, because completed settlements may not be reversible.

About The Opportunity

OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.
We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
  • Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
  • Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
  • Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
  • Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
  • Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.

Domain Depth
  • 5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.

  • End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.

  • You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
  • You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
  • Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
  • A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.

  • Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.

  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
